title: NCAA: Blazers stay unbeaten with big win over Lyceum
summary: College of St. Benilde is still undefeated in Group A of the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament after powering past Lyceum, 98-82, Thursday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan.
